title: Mountain Paddlers Kayak Rental
specs: access to both Grand Lake and Shadow Mountain Lake
chance to spot moose and other wildlife
Voted as one of Trip Advisor’s 'Top Things to Do' in Grand Lake, Colorado
Renters must be 18 or older, present a valid ID, and sign a Rental Agreement/Liability Waiver
Persons under 18 must have a parent or legal guardian sign the Rental Agreement/Liability Waiver
Children must weigh a minimum of 30 lbs
Children ages 14 and under must be accompanied by an adult
Infants and pets are not permitted in kayaks or paddleboards
discounts are offered for groups of 10+
includes: personal flotation device, safety whistle, 2L dry bag, and a paddle
gap: age minimum for children to paddle (other than weight) not explicitly stated
blurb: Mountain Paddlers Kayak Shak rents kayaks and paddleboards for exploring calm Grand Lake and scenic Shadow Mountain Lake. They provide a large, modern fleet suitable for all skill levels. Rentals include necessary equipment and are offered on a first come, first served basis. No reservations are needed except for very large groups.
extraNote: No reservations required except for very large groups · Extra time beyond pre-paid is charged in prorated half-hour increments · on the beach at the Kayak Shak, in front of Headwaters Marina
